text:
ana: Quick check — can we sync on today's kernel warmup handoff? I'm seeing weird tail latency on long sequences in canary.
mike: Which canary? 3 or 4?
ana: canary-3 (svc-runtime-eu). p50 looks fine, p99 spikes ~2-3x on seq>1024.
kevin: I pushed a micro-op change to kernel/ops that touches async eviction of KV entries. Could be related.
ana: Got a PR number?
kevin: PR #4127 — added guard for stale kv pointers + async-evict flag. Deployed to canary-3 at 08:10.
tara: I noticed CPU spillback traces in the same window, batching sizes were spiking. Might be bursting continuous batches.
mike: Can you paste the bench command and the config? Also what's continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens set to?
ana: Run I used: `./tools/bench --target canary-3 --seq 2048 --iters 100 --concurrency 8`
ana: Relevant config: `continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens=4096`, `continuous_batch.window_ms=25`
ana: Snippet from logs: `2026-03-17T08:11:02Z WARN kernel: kv-miss -> async-evict-queue-len=128 cpu-ms=42`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: finished deploy canary-3 (PR #4127) at 2026-03-17T08:10:12Z :white_check_mark:
kevin: I can flip the async-evict flag off on canary-3 to see if it stabilizes. That should isolate whether eviction async path causes the spillback.
ana: Yes please. Also can we add a short smoke test for seq>1024 to CI gate and an alert for p99 regressions? ping @mike
mike: On it — I'll add `thermal-smoke/long-seq` test and a regression alert (p99 > 1.5x baseline) to the console dashboards.
tara: To clarify owners: kernel/ops -> kevin, batching heuristics -> mike, runtime ops -> tara. Dep: infra might need to bump canary capacity if we re-run big benches.
kevin: I'll open an issue linking PR #4127 and add rollback option. ACTIONS: kevin - disable `async-evict` on canary-3; mike - add smoke test & alert; tara - monitor infra/canary capacity. Target: validate or rollback by EOD.
ana: I added kv.hit_ratio and batch_size to the canary metrics dashboard so we can watch correlations.
mike: :thumbsup: ping me when smoke test is pushed; I'll queue a fast CR review.
kevin: Disabled flag and initiating rollback now. Will post when done.
ops-bot: ops-bot: rollback initiated for canary-3 by kevin at 2026-03-17T08:32:01Z — status: in-progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ana: Watching. If p99 drops back to baseline after rollback we can attribute to the PR and revert.
tara: If baseline doesn't recover, we escalate to a perf triage and include heap/mem profiles and batch histograms.
mike: I'll try to get the CR review in the next 30m. If review blocks, we may do a temporary revert.
ana: Thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket and close the loop once we see rollback results.
